system.name: RDT-1B (Robotics Diffusion Transformer)
system.one_liner: A 1B-parameter diffusion transformer policy for bimanual manipulation, conditioned on language and images, pre-trained on many robots' data with a unified action space.

content.variant_note: two titled rounded frames (model sketch with a result bar chart, datasets) over a row of four captioned real-robot photo cards
content.argues: A pre-trained 1B diffusion policy beats baselines (68.2% vs 34.8% from scratch) and shows dexterity, few-shot learning, instruction following and zero-shot generalisation on a real dual-arm robot.
content.subject: RDT-1B model sketch with a unified action space and success-rate bars, the pre-training and fine-tuning data, and four real-robot capability photos.

evidence: Overview of Robotics Diffusion Transformer with 1B-Parameters (RDT-1B), a language-conditioned visuomotor policy for bimanual manipulation
The general performance in Fig. 1 of each method is calculated in three steps.
we further introduce a Physically Interpretable Unified Action Space, which can unify the action representations of various robots

summary: RDT-1B is a 1B-parameter diffusion transformer policy for bimanual robot manipulation, conditioned on language and images, pre-trained on a large multi-robot collection and fine-tuned on the authors' own dual-arm data. Figure 1 is an overview sheet. Top left, a titled frame holds a sketch of the Diffusion Transformer 1B fed by T5 and SigLIP with an iterative-denoising loop, a Unified Action Space panel that maps three robots into shared token slots, and a bar chart: 68.2% pre-trained against 34.8% from scratch and 12.2%, 1.7% and 1.6% for ACT, OpenVLA and Octo, with a star callout 'Boost by 33.4%'. Top right, a Datasets frame shows photo collages for 46 datasets (1M episodes) and the 6K-episode fine-tuning set. A bottom row of four photo cards shows dexterity, few-shot learning, instruction following and zero-shot generalisation.
summary_zh: RDT-1B 是面向双臂操作的 10 亿参数扩散 Transformer 策略。图 1 总览：左上为模型草图与成功率柱状图，右上为预训练与微调数据拼贴，下排四张真机照片展示灵巧、少样本、指令跟随和零样本泛化。
notes: The roles of T5 (language) and SigLIP (vision) are taken from the 'language-visuomotor policy' wording, not from a label. The meaning of the grey and magenta strip cells and of the dashed leader lines to the unified action space is read from the picture only. Picture counts for the two collages are approximate (the digest gives 44 bitmaps in all). The context file's abstract says 1.2B parameters while the figure says 1B.
